summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main technical tasks. First, data for 'provantage' was moved from the stage environment to production, and a manual recalc process was agreed upon to ensure future automation.

Second, an issue with the aggregation script (`device_session_agg_ml_staging`) was discussed. The minimum values observed on staging (1500) differed from those in `agg_ml` (<1500). [me] confirmed that a modified script, named `aka_test_1`, was used for testing on a private dataset and advised checking the analytics dashboard with this specific name.

It was decided that the updated script (`aka_test_1`) should remain on staging. [me] agreed to change the default selection process so that `aka_test_1` is always chosen when viewing data on staging, but it must not be promoted to production.
decisions: The 'provantage' data was moved from stage to prod.
A manual recalc procedure will be implemented for future automation.
The updated aggregation script (`aka_test_1`) is confirmed for use only on the staging environment.
action_items: [me] to change the default selection process to always choose `aka_test_1` when viewing data on staging.
